sampling: Include all annotated answer IDs, then fill to 500 unique texts from answer IDs sorted numerically and shuffled with Python random seed 42.
evaluation: 36 test + 12 development; 6 and 2 per query type. Single-source question IDs preserve original split. Multi-hop and unavailable questions are authored. Gold spans are selected from source answers.
limitation: Small constructed subset, not the official full InsuranceQA benchmark. Labels are not exhaustive; historical answers may be dated or wrong.
